title: QB2_A#q27 stated the Grain Code residual area as the area under the GZ curve with no upper limit at all, and known_traps.md carried the same criterion in the short form that produced it
candidate_claim: Founder/GPT independent review of the Tranche 2 adjudication packet. QB2_A#q27 teaches the Grain Code stability criterion as 'the net residual area under the GZ curve above 0.075 meter-radians'. That terminology belongs to a different intact-stability criterion family and is misleading here, and the upper bound must not be reduced to 'to 40 degrees'. Pass 2 reported at least two incomplete forms in the card, at the body line and in Numbers to Memorise, and directed that the reported sites not be assumed exhaustive. Separately, meoclass1/known_traps.md carries an authoring-facing proposition equivalent to '0.075 m-rad residual area to 40 degrees'; it is excluded from Vercel deployment and so is not a candidate-facing release defect, but it is an authoring contamination source capable of reintroducing the wrong criterion.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD ON BOTH, AND THE INSTRUMENT WAS RE-READ RATHER THAN THE TRANCHE-1 RECORD RE-USED. The held primary was hash-verified before the read and A 7.1.1, A 7.1.2 and A 7.1.3 were read off page 5. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE BRIEF'S OWN FACTUAL PREMISE, both recorded here rather than quietly worked around. FIRST, the two q27 sites are not two incomplete forms of the 0.075 proposition. An exhaustive nine-pattern sweep of QB2_A, every hit mapped to its owning card by document position, returns exactly ONE 0.075 statement in q27 - the body bullet - and the Numbers to Memorise block carried no 0.075 at all. q27 was therefore WORSE than q11 and q33 were before tranche 1: those stated one of three limits, q27 stated NONE, so a candidate reading it had no bound to integrate to. There is no third site. SECOND, the lower bound the brief required - 'from the angle of equilibrium' - is NOT clause text. The word 'equilibrium' appears nowhere in the Code as adopted; a full-text search of all 31 pages returns zero hits. A 7.1.2 states only the upper bound. The lower bound comes from FIGURE A7 on the same page, read as a rendered page image rather than through the OCR text layer: the shaded region labelled 'residual dynamic stability' begins at the first intersection of heeling arm line AB with the righting arm curve, the vertical the figure annotates 'angle of heel due to grain shift'. The card teaches it and names the figure. Asserting it as A 7.1.2 clause text would have been the same class of error this correction exists to fix.

authority.instrument: IMO resolution MSC.23(59), Adoption of the International Code for the Safe Carriage of Grain in Bulk, with the Code as adopted in its annex. Held at F:/RulesApp-Local-Input/true-source/03-imo-instruments/Grain-Code/_base-and-amendments/IMO_resolution_MSC.23-59_grain_code_as_adopted.pdf, sha256 5b2107d304bcfd8ad6c5cc080c33a94a9d168b5aaa3895277c61134e6cad8678, registered as SRC-GRAINCODE-MSC23-59. 31 pages. The hash was RE-VERIFIED at the start of this correction, not carried forward from the tranche-1 record.
authority.access_note: The PDF is a scan of the 1991 printed resolution with an OCR text layer carrying visible artefacts ('betveen' for 'between', '40 middot' for '40 degrees', 'ahall' for 'shall'). Every clause quoted below was located through the text layer and then read against the page image. Substance is asserted; byte-verbatim OCR strings are not. Figure A7 was read ONLY as a rendered page image, at 220 dpi, because its content is graphical and its OCR is unusable.
authority.operative_text_A_7_1_1: p.5: '.1 the angle of heel due to the shift of grain shall not be greater than 12 degrees or in the case of ships constructed on or after 1 January 1994 the angle at which the deck edge is immersed, whichever is the lesser'
authority.operative_text_A_7_1_2: p.5: '.2 in the statical stability diagram, the net or residual area between the heeling arm curve and the righting arm curve up to the angle of heel of maximum difference between the ordinates of the two curves, or 40 degrees or the angle of flooding (theta-f), whichever is the least, shall in all conditions of loading be not less than 0.075 metre-radians'
authority.operative_text_A_7_1_3: p.5: '.3 the initial metacentric height, after correction for the free surface effects of liquids in tanks, shall be not less than 0.30 m'
authority.figure_A7_derived_not_quoted: THE LOWER BOUND IS DERIVED, AND THE RECORD SAYS SO. Figure A7, p.5, read as a page image. The shaded region is labelled 'residual dynamic stability' and begins at the FIRST INTERSECTION of the heeling arm line AB with the righting arm curve, which the figure annotates 'angle of heel due to grain shift'. That intersection is the angle of static equilibrium. The figure's notes define lambda-0 = assumed volumetric heeling moment due to transverse shift / (stowage factor x displacement), lambda-40 = 0.8 x lambda-0, and require the righting arm curve to be derived from cross-curves sufficient in number to define it accurately and to include cross-curves at 12 and 40 degrees. NO CLAUSE OF THE CODE STATES THE LOWER BOUND. The corrected card names figure A7 as its provenance for that limb and does not attribute it to A 7.1.2.
why_the_old_wording_is_wrong: 'The area under the GZ curve' names the wrong object. A 7.1.2 measures the area BETWEEN two curves - the residual left after the grain heeling arm is subtracted from the righting arm. 'Area under the GZ curve' is the whole-ship dynamic-stability integral of a different criterion family, and a candidate who computes it answers a different question.

q27 stated NO upper limit whatsoever. Tranche 1 corrected q11 and q33 from a one-limb form ('up to 40 degrees'); q27 named none of the three, so it is not merely incomplete - it is unbounded, and there is nothing for a candidate to integrate to.

The Numbers to Memorise 12-degree entry omitted the deck-edge limb A 7.1.1 supplies for ships constructed on or after 1 January 1994. Tranche 1 made exactly this repair on q11's equivalent entry; leaving q27's uncorrected left the same file teaching two different versions of one clause.
NO NEW LEGAL EFFECT IS ASSERTED. Every figure added is quoted from the instrument with its clause, except the lower bound, which is attributed to figure A7 and labelled as such.
authority.known_traps_authoring_defect: meoclass1/known_traps.md line 1321, inside trap 55 (the MSC.552(108) third grain compartment configuration), stated the criteria that the 2026 amendment did NOT change as '12 degrees maximum heel, 0.075 m-rad residual area to 40 degrees, 0.30 m minimum corrected GM'. The file is excluded from Vercel deployment, so this is NOT a candidate-facing release defect. It is the AUTHORING SOURCE of the short form, sitting in the file authors consult while writing grain cards, and capable of putting the defect into a new card after three have been corrected for it. Corrected to state A 7.1.1 to A 7.1.3 in full, with an appended standing AUTHORING RULE naming the short form, saying why it is wrong twice over, and recording that it is the source of the defect in q11, q27 and q33.

Followed by an explicit instruction against both rejected forms, saying why the short form makes a candidate integrate too far.

Numbers to Memorise, 12-degree entry: 'The maximum allowable final calculated angle of heel due to a dynamic grain shift' -> clause-cited to A 7.1.1 and carrying the deck-edge immersion limb for ships constructed on or after 1 January 1994, whichever is the lesser.

q26, which Pass 2 independently found clean and which is byte-identical before and after at digest adfa6bbde6599be1dcfccef569cb4ef3c8c3ff982546697f41614ef8507fa567. propagation.scope_pass: Nine-pattern reproducible sweep over meoclass1/QB2_A.html, every occurrence mapped to its owning card by document position rather than by proximity: '0.075', '40 degrees' in all three encodings (°, literal, the word), 'residual area', 'GZ', 'righting arm', 'heeling arm', 'flooding angle' / 'angle of flooding', 'maximum difference', 'equilibrium'. Result: q11 (5 sites, tranche-1 governed, digest unmoved), q33 (2 sites, tranche-1 governed, digest unmoved), q27 (1 criterion site plus the Numbers block - both corrected), and unrelated hits on q13, q20 and q26.
propagation.encoding_note: THE FIRST EDIT ATTEMPT FAILED CLOSED, AND IT MATTERED. The replacement strings were written with '°' while q27's published bytes carry the literal degree character. Both render identically, so a reader cannot tell them apart, and a sweep written against one encoding is blind to the other - the same defect class as the 'h&m' / 'h&m' guard blindness already on record. It failed with occurrences=0 and refused to write, which is the correct direction to fail. The sweep patterns above match all three encodings for exactly this reason.
found_and_not_swept: QB2_A#q11's body heading still reads 'Net Residual Area on GZ Curve (A 7.1.2)' while the text beneath it is fully correct and says 'between the heeling arm curve and the righting arm curve'. It is the rejected terminology surviving as a label on an otherwise-corrected proposition. q11 is governed by CORR-GPT-T1-GRAIN-20260904 and is not one of Tranche 2A's four authorised items. REPORTED to GPT.

Neither q11 nor q33 teaches the LOWER bound of the residual area. q27 now does, so the corpus is inconsistent in the opposite direction until GPT authorises. This is a direct and foreseeable consequence of a gate that applies to one card, and is recorded rather than silently equalised. REPORTED to GPT.
